A young maker brand

Color, creativity, and connection.

CharmNest was started by a young bracelet maker who loves turning favorite colors, little charms, and friendship ideas into something people can wear.

The business starts simple: one confirmed school-drop color scheme at a time, controlled custom options, and online products priced to cover the extra work of personalization and fulfillment.

Privacy matters: the public site does not publish the maker’s full legal name, exact age, school, home address, personal phone number, or face.

Handmade friendship and charm bracelets for colors, people, and moments worth keeping.
